title: China's Share of EU Imports (2019-2024)
executive_question: Has China's share of EU imports plateaued since 2022?
required_metrics: Value: China's share of extra-EU imports (percentage)
comparison_set: None (single series); optionally add EU imports from Vietnam or India for diversification context.
search_queries: Eurostat China share of extra-EU imports 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023
China share of EU imports percentage 2024 Eurostat
data_quality_rule: Use official Eurostat data; if 2024 data is incomplete, use first three quarters annualized. If only two endpoints available, estimate intermediate values using CAGR and mark as estimates.
narrative_role: Provide evidence for the claim that trade diversification and geopolitical tensions have halted China's import share growth.
pre_exhibit_context: The report argues that China's share of EU imports has plateaued. This exhibit tests that hypothesis with annual data.
post_exhibit_takeaway: If the share is flat or declining, it supports the plateau thesis; if still rising, the hypothesis needs revision.

title: Chinese FDI in Europe by Sector (2020-2024)
executive_question: Which sectors are attracting Chinese investment and how has the mix changed?
required_metrics: Segment: By sector (e.g., automotive, batteries, technology, infrastructure) and by type (M&A vs greenfield)
comparison_set: Sectors compared within each year; optionally compare M&A vs greenfield totals.
search_queries: Chinese FDI in Europe by sector 2020 2021 2022 2023 fDi Markets
Chinese greenfield investment Europe EV battery 2023 2024
data_quality_rule: Use fDi Markets for greenfield, Refinitiv for M&A; if sector breakdown incomplete, use top 5 sectors. Mark estimates if data is partial.
narrative_role: Show the shift from M&A to greenfield in EV and battery sectors.
pre_exhibit_context: The report claims Chinese FDI is pivoting to greenfield in EVs and batteries. This exhibit breaks down FDI by sector and type.
post_exhibit_takeaway: If EV/battery greenfield dominates recent years, the pivot is confirmed; if M&A still leads, the hypothesis is weak.

title: Impact of EU Tariffs on Chinese EV Market Share
executive_question: How much market share could Chinese EVs lose due to EU anti-subsidy tariffs?
required_metrics: Value: Chinese EV market share in EU (percentage of total EV sales)
comparison_set: Baseline scenario (no tariff) vs tariff scenario.
search_queries: Chinese EV market share Europe 2022 2023 2024 ACEA
EU anti-subsidy tariff Chinese EVs impact estimate 2025 2026
data_quality_rule: Use actual sales data for 2022-2024; for 2025-2026, use public forecasts or estimate using CAGR from 2022-2024 and apply tariff elasticity. Mark forecast years as estimates.
narrative_role: Quantify the potential impact of tariff increases on Chinese EV market share in Europe.
pre_exhibit_context: The report hypothesizes that EU tariffs will reduce Chinese EV market share by 10-15% by 2026. This exhibit models the impact.
post_exhibit_takeaway: If the model shows a 10-15% drop, the hypothesis is supported; if less, the impact may be overstated.

title: CBAM Cost Impact on Chinese Steel Exports
executive_question: Which Chinese steel products are most exposed to CBAM costs?
required_metrics: Value: Export volume (tonnes) and carbon intensity (kg CO2 per tonne)
Segment: By HS code (e.g., 7208, 7209, 7210) and by EU importing country
comparison_set: Products compared by carbon intensity and export volume.
search_queries: Chinese steel exports to EU by HS code 2023 volume
carbon intensity Chinese steel production kg CO2 per tonne
data_quality_rule: Use official trade data for volumes; carbon intensity from World Steel Association or academic sources. If product-level carbon data unavailable, use sector averages.
narrative_role: Identify the products and countries most affected by the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism.
pre_exhibit_context: The report claims CBAM will significantly increase costs for Chinese steel and aluminum. This exhibit maps the exposure.
post_exhibit_takeaway: If certain products (e.g., flat-rolled steel) have high carbon intensity and export volume, they are most at risk.

title: Chinese Battery Gigafactory Capacity in Europe (2022-2026)
executive_question: How much battery production capacity are Chinese companies building in Europe?
required_metrics: Entity: Chinese companies (CATL, BYD, SVOLT, etc.)
Segment: By company and by country (Hungary, Germany, etc.)
comparison_set: Companies compared; optionally add total European battery demand.
search_queries: CATL battery factory Hungary capacity GWh 2023
Chinese battery gigafactories Europe announced capacity 2024 2025
data_quality_rule: Use announced capacities from company press releases; if actual production data unavailable, use announced. Mark as 'announced' not 'operational'.
narrative_role: Show the scale and timeline of Chinese investment in European battery manufacturing.
pre_exhibit_context: The report highlights Chinese FDI in EV batteries. This exhibit quantifies the capacity buildout.
post_exhibit_takeaway: If capacity is large and growing, it confirms the greenfield pivot; if delayed, the impact may be slower.

Chinese green bonds denominated in euros amount 2024
data_quality_rule: Use Climate Bonds Initiative data; if 2024 data incomplete, use first three quarters annualized. If only two endpoints, estimate using CAGR and mark as estimates.
